assessments.reasoning: The FSF's 1.1 definition at [2781,2968) identifies the source of the passages. Section 3 at [5354,6310) supplies the printed-copy, quantity and notice conditions and the overflow guidance. The broader media wording appears in the later editions.

limitations: The same paragraph also requires clear publisher identification on both covers and the full title on the front with equal prominence and visibility for its words. The claim addresses text placement only.
The authorized notice supplies the required passages. The license's sample notice supplies no facts about a particular work.
reasoning: In 1.1, §1 identifies Cover Texts by their listing in the Document's notice. Section 3 requires their legible placement on the designated front or back cover when the publisher issues more than 100 printed copies and the notice requires them. For overflow, the paragraph advises placing the earliest listed passages that reasonably fit on the cover and continuing the remainder on adjacent pages.
